feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was super punchy—saying a 175B model still spews garbage got me immediately. The stat at the end about a 1.3B model beating a 175B model is wild. My only gripe is in Beat 4: 'clipped surrogate objectives' sounds like you copy-pasted directly from John Schulman's PPO paper abstract. It momentarily broke my flow, even though the next sentence about the KL penalty made total sense.
